angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 260,192 km at 31.61 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 31.6386 +/- 0.0231 mas (same row, RUWE 1.36): 31.61 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.374 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Mistry et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4559 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract): 260,192 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.392 +/- 0.027 solar masses from Mistry et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4559 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3558 +/- 73 K from Mistry et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4559 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mistry et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4559 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-4559.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.886, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, LP 912-46: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4559 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.09 dex, from Mistry et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4559 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.6925, from Mistry et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4559 (pscomppars): age 7 Gyr, from Mistry et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024PASA...41...30M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
